arguments.command:
cat > /app/tmp/t/test_proto1.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/tmp/t")
from harness import *

ok = True

# 1. empty trace
ok &= check("empty trace", CFG(), [],
            RES("t", [], conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# 2. empty traces list
req = {"version":1,"traces":[]}
from run import run_json
rc,out,err = run_json(req)
got = json.loads(out) if rc==0 else out
print(("PASS " if got=={"version":1,"results":[]} else "FAIL ")+"empty traces"); ok &= got=={"version":1,"results":[]}

# 3. LAYOUT: A packet not final
ok &= check("layout A not final", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("A",1,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","LAYOUT",0),pres(0,1,"dropped","LAYOUT",0)],
                conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# A final only -> fine but A key absent -> queued
ok &= check("layout single A", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"buffered","NO_KEYS",0)], conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# I then A: A is final -> no layout violation; I accepted, A queued
ok &= check("layout I then A", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("A",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0),pres(0,1,"buffered","NO_KEYS",0)],
                conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# A then I: A not final -> LAYOUT for all
ok &= check("layout A then I", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","LAYOUT",0),pres(0,1,"dropped","LAYOUT",0)],
                conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# Z packet not final is fine (only A checked)
ok &= check("layout Z not final", CFG(early=True), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("Z",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0),pres(0,1,"accepted","OK",0)],
                conn_open(0), KEYS(z="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# 4. INITIAL_TOO_SMALL
ok &= check("initial too small", CFG(), [dg(0,1199,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","INITIAL_TOO_SMALL",0)], conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("initial exactly 1200", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,None)], conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,src(0,0,None)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# small datagram, H packet: not affected
ok &= check("small datagram H ok", CFG(), [dg(0,100,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"buffered","NO_KEYS",0)], conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# small datagram: I dropped, other packet continues
ok &= check("small datagram mixed", CFG(), [dg(0,1199,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","INITIAL_TOO_SMALL",0),pres(0,1,"buffered","NO_KEYS",0)],
                conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# 5. EARLY_REJECTED
ok &= check("early rejected", CFG(early=False), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("Z",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","EARLY_REJECTED",0)], conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# early=false but Z key installed -> still EARLY_REJECTED (rule 3 before key state)
ok &= check("early rejected even with live Z", CFG(early=False), [key(0,"Z","install"),dg(1,1200,[pkt("Z",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(1,0,"dropped","EARLY_REJECTED",1)], conn_open(), KEYS(z="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# early=false, Z key discarded -> EARLY_REJECTED (rule 3 before rule 4)
ok &= check("early rejected before discarded", CFG(early=False), [key(0,"Z","discard"),dg(1,1200,[pkt("Z",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(1,0,"dropped","EARLY_REJECTED",1)], conn_open(), KEYS(z="discarded"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# early=true, Z live -> accepted
ok &= check("early accepted", CFG(early=True), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("Z",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(z="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# early=true, Z discarded -> KEYS_DISCARDED
ok &= check("Z discarded", CFG(early=True), [key(0,"Z","discard"),dg(1,1200,[pkt("Z",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(1,0,"dropped","KEYS_DISCARDED",1)], conn_open(), KEYS(z="discarded"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# 6. KEYS_DISCARDED for I; pending dropped at discard time
ok &= check("I discarded", CFG(), [key(0,"I","discard"),dg(1,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(1,0,"dropped","KEYS_DISCARDED",1)], conn_open(), KEYS(i="discarded"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("discard drops pending", CFG(buffer_packets=4), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])]), dg(1,1200,[pkt("H",1,True,[PAD()]),pkt("A",0,True,[PAD()])]),
        key(5,"H","discard")],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","KEYS_DISCARDED",5),pres(1,0,"dropped","KEYS_DISCARDED",5),pres(1,1,"buffered","NO_KEYS",1)],
        conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# discard absent key with pending -> also drops them
ok &= check("discard absent drops pending", CFG(buffer_packets=4), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])]), key(1,"H","discard")],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","KEYS_DISCARDED",1)], conn_open(), KEYS(h="discarded"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# install after discard is a no-op
ok &= check("install discarded noop", CFG(), [key(0,"H","discard"),key(1,"H","install"),dg(2,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(2,0,"dropped","KEYS_DISCARDED",2)], conn_open(), KEYS(h="discarded"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# install live is a no-op
ok &= check("install live noop", CFG(), [key(0,"I","install"),dg(1,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# discard I (live) then packets
ok &= check("discard live I", CFG(), [key(0,"I","discard"),dg(1,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("I",1,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(1,0,"dropped","KEYS_DISCARDED",1),pres(1,1,"dropped","KEYS_DISCARDED",1)],
                conn_open(), KEYS(i="discarded"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# 7. BUFFER_FULL
ok &= check("buffer full 0", CFG(buffer_packets=0), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","BUFFER_FULL",0)], conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("buffer full 2->3rd", CFG(buffer_packets=2), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])]),dg(1,1200,[pkt("H",1,True,[PAD()])]),dg(2,1200,[pkt("H",2,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"buffered","NO_KEYS",0),pres(1,0,"buffered","NO_KEYS",1),pres(2,0,"dropped","BUFFER_FULL",2)],
        conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# queued packet that will fail auth still consumes a slot
ok &= check("buffer slot by auth-fail packet", CFG(buffer_packets=1), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",0,False,[PAD()])]),dg(1,1200,[pkt("H",1,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"buffered","NO_KEYS",0),pres(1,0,"dropped","BUFFER_FULL",1)],
        conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# mixed levels share the queue
ok &= check("queue shared across levels", CFG(buffer_packets=2), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])]),dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[PAD()])]),dg(2,1200,[pkt("H",1,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"buffered","NO_KEYS",0),pres(1,0,"buffered","NO_KEYS",1),pres(2,0,"dropped","BUFFER_FULL",2)],
        conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# 8. AUTH
ok &= check("auth fail", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,False,[UNK()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","AUTH",0)], conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# auth fail does not update activity
ok &= check("auth no activity", CFG(idle_ms=10), [dg(5,1200,[pkt("I",0,False,[PAD()])]),tick(20)],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","AUTH",5)], conn_idle(10, src(1), 0), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# 9. DUPLICATE
ok &= check("duplicate I", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()])]),dg(1,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[UNK()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0),pres(1,0,"duplicate","DUPLICATE",1)],
                conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# I and H have separate PN spaces
ok &= check("separate I/H spaces", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()])]),dg(1,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])])],
            RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0),pres(1,0,"buffered","NO_KEYS",1)],
                conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# Z and A share the Application space
ok &= check("Z/A shared space", CFG(early=True), [
        key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("Z",7,True,[PAD()])]),
        dg(2,1200,[pkt("A",7,True,[UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1),pres(2,0,"duplicate","DUPLICATE",2)],
        conn_open(1), KEYS(z="live",a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# A then Z duplicate
ok &= check("A/Z shared space 2", CFG(early=True), [
        key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",3,True,[PAD()])]),
        dg(2,1200,[pkt("Z",3,True,[UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1),pres(2,0,"duplicate","DUPLICATE",2)],
        conn_open(1), KEYS(z="live",a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# duplicate does not update activity
ok &= check("duplicate no activity", CFG(idle_ms=10), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()])]),dg(5,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()])]),tick(20)],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0),pres(1,0,"duplicate","DUPLICATE",5)],
        conn_idle(10, src(2), 0), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# error packet does not mark PN: same pn again is not duplicate
ok &= check("error no pn mark", CFG(), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[UNK()])]),dg(1,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,0)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,src(0,0,0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

print("ALL PASS" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/t && python3 test_proto1.py
